title: Orders requests hang then fail
query: Requests to orders hang for about three seconds and then fail. The logs say it timed out waiting for a connection.
root_cause: The orders database connection pool is exhausted because connections are held and not returned.

remediation.detail: Restart orders to release the held connections.

evidence: Failing orders requests take about three seconds, matching the pool timeout
Orders logs say it could not get a connection
query_paraphrase: Calls to orders sit there for around three seconds and then fail, and the log says it gave up waiting to get hold of a database connection.
